verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search engine, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. First-party docs and an integration page describe an official MCP server that lets an agent create indexes, add documents, tune ranking rules and settings, and run searches from the AI client the user already uses. missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works, and thin detail on setup, configuration, transport and tool list.
